facts: Parties: Saltash Technologies Ltd (Buyer), Kestrel Energy plc (Seller); the Company is Redcliffe Industries Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 20 January 2026; Closing is scheduled for 31 March 2026 (the 'Closing Date').

Section 10.1 (Survival): the General Warranties survive Closing for 18 months; the Fundamental Warranties (title, capacity, tax) survive for 72 months. Claims must be notified in writing before expiry.

Section 9.4 (De Minimis and Basket): the Seller shall not be liable unless the aggregate of all claims exceeds $650,000 (1.0% of the Purchase Price), in which case the Seller shall be liable only for the excess over that amount.
Section 9.7: the Buyer must notify any warranty claim within 30 days of becoming aware of it.
Section 4.5: if the Conditions are not satisfied by the date falling 120 days after the date of this Agreement (signed 20 January 2026), either party may terminate.
Section 12.1: the Seller shall not compete with the business for 4 years after Closing.
Clause 5.2: a claim against the Escrow Amount must be notified within 45 days of the Buyer becoming aware of it.
Regulatory counsel expects merger clearance by 3 June 2026.
Clause 18: the Founder shall not compete with the business for 18 months after termination of employment.
